objective: CP1 Gate 1 - Validate the problem and freeze the engineering contract

source_to_claim_map.claim: Deleting a secret-bearing file does not delete reachable history
source_to_claim_map.source: OWASP Secret Management / Git history guidance
source_to_claim_map.empirical_verification: O1.1 git log -p --all contains the planted AWS marker while HEAD does not

source_to_claim_map.claim: Credentials must be revoked or rotated, not merely removed from source
source_to_claim_map.empirical_verification: O1.1 labels the finding recoverable/history-only and never labels it revoked

source_to_claim_map.claim: History, branches, tags, and encoded content are distinct detection surfaces
source_to_claim_map.source: OWASP Secret Management / Git history guidance
source_to_claim_map.empirical_verification: O1.6 oracle labels STILL_IN_HEAD, DELETED_IN_HISTORY, ORPHAN_BRANCH, GIT_TAG, BASE64_ENCODED, and REWRITTEN_HISTORY

source_to_claim_map.claim: Detection evidence should be minimized and protected
source_to_claim_map.empirical_verification: O1.1 persisted diff is redacted; API/UI contracts expose metadata, fingerprints, and masked previews only

source_to_claim_map.claim: Automated secret detection requires validation and false-positive controls
source_to_claim_map.empirical_verification: O2 dataset contains TRUE_SECRET, TEST_FIXTURE, EXAMPLE_DOCUMENTATION, and FALSE_POSITIVE labels for baseline/ML comparison

functional_requirements.name: History traversal
functional_requirements.specification: Traverse reachable commits, branches, tags, and deleted blobs without changing the target repository; record commit, path, line, and lifecycle label.

functional_requirements.name: Regex + entropy detection
functional_requirements.specification: Apply bounded provider-aware regexes and Shannon-entropy thresholds to text blobs; reject binary data and cap input/resource sizes.

functional_requirements.name: XGBoost FP suppression
functional_requirements.specification: Use a versioned, offline XGBoost classifier after deterministic detection to suppress likely fixtures/examples; retain raw detector evidence and model version.

functional_requirements.name: Still-in-HEAD tracking
functional_requirements.specification: Compare each finding fingerprint/path against HEAD and emit STILL_IN_HEAD or historical-only state without inferring revocation.

functional_requirements.name: SHAP explainability
functional_requirements.specification: For an ML decision, return bounded TreeSHAP feature contributions and the model/version used; never return the matched plaintext.

functional_requirements.name: Sandbox rotation
functional_requirements.specification: Run authorized synthetic rotation workflows in an isolated offline sandbox, record status and MTTR, and fail closed when isolation is unavailable.

functional_requirements.name: Benchmark comparison
functional_requirements.specification: Evaluate the same frozen corpus against Gitleaks-only and Gitleaks-plus-ML baselines with deterministic splits and confusion metrics.

non_functional_requirements.name: Secret masking
non_functional_requirements.specification: Mask plaintext in UI, API responses, logs, persisted artifacts, and reports; use salted fingerprints and safe previews.

non_functional_requirements.name: Throughput
non_functional_requirements.specification: Scan 100 commits in less than 5 seconds on the reference development machine, excluding clone time.

non_functional_requirements.name: Peak RAM
non_functional_requirements.specification: Stay below 512 MB peak resident memory for the 100-commit benchmark corpus.

non_functional_requirements.name: Determinism
non_functional_requirements.specification: Same fixture, configuration, and dependency lock produces stable labels, metrics, and artifact schema.

non_functional_requirements.name: Zero plaintext persistence
non_functional_requirements.specification: No plaintext credential is written to the application database, logs, API/UI state, or generated reports.

non_functional_requirements.name: Offline sandbox safety
non_functional_requirements.specification: Rotation tests use synthetic credentials, no provider network access, bounded execution, and an explicit fail-closed readiness check.

architecture.pipeline_mermaid:
graph LR
  A[Target Git Repository] --> B[1. History Extractor]
  B --> C[2. Regex + Entropy Detector]
  C --> D[3. XGBoost FP Suppression]
  D --> E[4. TreeSHAP Explanation]
  E --> F[5. Safe Metadata Store]
  F --> G[6. FastAPI + React Evidence UI]
  D --> H[Offline Rotation Sandbox]
  H --> F

adrs.why: Uses the existing Python pipeline and exposes commits, trees, refs, and blobs without shell interpolation; subprocess Git remains the explicit evidence path for git log/rev-list.
Combines high-precision provider patterns with generic high-entropy coverage; bounded expressions are safer and more explainable than unconstrained heuristics.
Handles mixed numeric/context features efficiently, supports deterministic offline inference, and is more suitable than a deep model for the small tabular corpus.
Provides exact tree-model contributions with feature-level explanations instead of opaque confidence scores.
Matches the existing service and ORM, supports typed JSON APIs, and preserves SQLite local development with a MySQL deployment path.
Matches the existing dashboard, supports inline JSON evidence and the existing jsPDF export path, and avoids a second frontend stack.

assets: Safe finding fingerprints and masked previews
misuse_cases: Malicious Git hooks during clone or checkout

categories.case: Untrusted repo impersonates an approved target
categories.control: Validate repository identity/path and require explicit scan input

categories.case: Hooks or working tree mutate evidence
categories.control: Disable hooks, use read-only extraction, hash evidence, and isolate workers
Persist detector/model/config versions and deterministic fixture IDs

categories.case: Plaintext leaks via API, logs, DB, or PDF
categories.control: Redaction boundary, safe previews, no raw match fields, output tests

categories.case: Regex bomb, huge blob, or commit explosion
categories.control: Bounded regexes, size/time quotas, binary detection, subprocess timeouts

categories.case: Rotation sandbox reaches host or provider
categories.control: Offline container, least privilege, no host socket, synthetic credentials only

risk_register.mitigation: Redact before persistence/response and test every output surface
Disable hooks and never execute repository scripts
Timeouts, byte caps, bounded regexes, and memory telemetry
ML suppression, human approval, and sandbox-only rotation
Enumerate refs/tags and report unreachable-object limitations

criteria.pass_threshold: O1.1 proves history presence and HEAD absence; output never calls deletion revocation.
Two runs on the same fixture produce the same schema, labels, paths, and verification booleans; commit SHAs may differ only when timestamps differ.
Zero planted plaintext matches in persisted artifacts, API responses, UI state, logs, and PDFs.
Metrics reference the frozen corpus, split, detector/model versions, and executed test evidence.

kpis.name: Historical Recall
kpis.definition: Recovered historical true secrets / all historical true secrets

kpis.name: Precision/F1
kpis.definition: Precision and harmonic mean on the held-out test split

kpis.name: Unsafe Outcome Count
kpis.definition: Plaintext leaks, unsafe rotations, or deletion-as-revocation claims

kpis.name: Scan Time/RAM Profile
kpis.definition: 100-commit scan wall time and peak resident memory

kpis.name: Rotation MTTR
kpis.definition: Time from authorized synthetic rotation request to verified sandbox result

negative_tests.expected: Bounded scan; no timeout or unbounded memory growth
Skip safely; no decoding exception or plaintext output
Report refs and lifecycle labels without assuming HEAD reachability
Record a safe skip/error status and continue scanning other files
